source_record.title: Revisiting scaling laws for reward optimization
source_record.problem: 现有奖励过优化曲线不能清楚量化比较数据数量如何限制可支持的策略偏移。
source_record.insight: 将比较数 M 与期望 KL 预算 K 分开，用信息论选择模型推导可达奖励增益的联合界，并检验扫描优化强度所得峰值随比较数的拟合。
source_record.limitation: 独立高斯奖励、非自适应配对及不知道奖励的参考策略等理论假设；下界为构造性存在结果；实验以70B模型评分而非真实人类意图；主要验证峰值随M的关系，固定池tilting非实际RL训练；无全成本或二维外推保证。
source_record.sections_read: 原站元数据和版本史；v1 §§1–6，§3信息结构、§4定理及主文上界证明，Appendix A.2下界构造、A.3关键排名与有限预算步骤定向阅读，B.1–B.3实验设置、表1与表3、C图注；未逐式独立验算所有证明、未视觉审计曲线或复现代码。
source_record.evidence_status: 2026-09-29 20:43:25 UTC首发，仅v1。原理论及合成gold-RM实验，非独立复现。
source_record.method: Gaussian reward selection with separate comparison and expected-KL constraints; Qwen3 proxy reward fitting followed by best-of-N and fixed-pool exponential reweighting.
source_record.result: Supports a comparison-limited peak-reward trend under the tested synthetic-gold setup; not a universal compute scaling law or human-preference validation.

insertion.location: §2 after the Gao empirical curves and their gold-RM/KL limits, before §3 self-training; preferably a short subheading linking preference-data supply to optimization pressure.

proposed_body_additions.proposed_chinese:
Aouad、El Gadarri 与 Farias 进一步追问：偏好数据能支持多大的奖励优化压力？在回答奖励为独立高斯变量、比较配对不依赖奖励、参考策略不知道奖励等假设下，当提示间重叠比例固定时，其界给出的可达奖励增益阶为 $\sqrt{\min\{\log M,K\}}$。其中 $M$ 是比较数量，$K$ 是期望 KL 散度预算，并非 FLOPs。下界依赖专门构造的比较集、代理和参考策略；它不保证常规 RM 训练达到该界，也没有证明超过该范围的所有策略都会退化。

实验使用 70B gold RM 和 0.6B–4B Qwen3 代理，把 $M$ 从 600 扩到 300,000 时增加提示数、保持每题 300 对比较；评估使用不参与训练的 128 个提示，每题 8,192 个回答。主要拟合对象是扫描优化网格后取得的 gold 奖励峰值随 $M$ 的变化，并非已验证任意 $(M,K)$ 上的二维预测。指数倾斜也只是固定回答池的重加权，没有实际训练新策略。这把反馈供给接到了优化上限问题，但真实人类偏好、自适应收集和算力最优配置仍未解决。[原文 §3–6、附录 B](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.38526v1)
proposed_body_additions.proposed_english:
Aouad, El Gadarri, and Farias ask how preference data limits the optimization pressure a reward model can support. Under independent Gaussian response rewards, reward-independent comparison pairs, and a reward-blind reference policy, their bounds give attainable reward gains of order $\sqrt{\min\{\log M,K\}}$ when prompt overlap is fixed. Here $M$ counts comparisons and $K$ bounds expected KL divergence, not FLOPs. The lower bound uses a constructed comparison set, proxy, and reference policy; it does not guarantee that ordinary reward-model training attains the bound or prove that every policy deteriorates beyond it.

Experiments use a 70B gold reward model and 0.6B–4B Qwen3 proxies. Increasing $M$ from 600 to 300,000 adds prompts while retaining 300 comparisons per prompt. Evaluation uses 128 disjoint prompts with 8,192 responses each. The principal fit concerns the gold-reward peak selected over an optimization grid as a function of $M$, rather than a validated two-dimensional forecast for arbitrary $(M,K)$. Exponential tilting reweights fixed response pools; it is not an actual policy-training experiment. This connects feedback supply to optimization limits, while leaving human preferences, adaptive data collection, and compute-optimal allocation unresolved. [Original paper, §§3–6 and Appendix B](https://arxiv.org/html/2609.38526v1)

theory.admissibility: Each response belongs to prompt admissible set independently with probability p; A independent of rewards and preference data.
theory.pair_collection: E independent of R and A; not adaptive reward-driven preference collection.
theory.reference: Reward-blind pi0; expected base reward mu.
theory.lower_bound: Existential construction with m=floor(sqrt(2M)) responses, all pairs, posterior-mean proxy and constructed reward-blind base; lower order sigma sqrt(min{K,log(p sqrt(2M))}) for p sqrt(2M)>=4.
theory.noise: Independent Bradley–Terry labels; finite lower constant depends on beta/sigma.
theory.interpretation: For fixed overlap and growing effective budgets, matching order in M,K. The upper bound is not a theorem of inevitable reward decline above a threshold.

experiment.gold: Llama-3.3-Nemotron-70B-Reward; simulated gold, not human ground truth.
experiment.M_change: Expands prompt coverage in fixed reward-independent order, holding within-prompt comparisons fixed.
experiment.optimization: One pass of full-parameter pairwise logistic training, AdamW constant LR1e-5; LR chosen using distinct validation prompts.
experiment.BoN_pressure_coordinate: K_N=log(N)-(N-1)/N; conventional coordinate, not measured FLOPs.
experiment.target: Peak standardized gold gain over observed N grid as a function of M.
experiment.tilting: Uniform empirical reference over each fixed 8192-response pool, exponential proxy-score reweighting; not PPO or newly trained policy.
experiment.peak_selection: Uses observed gold rewards to choose peak N; not a deployable gold-free tuning procedure.

fit_cautions: Table1 square-root-log R² ranges 0.947–0.992 across all listed settings; abstract 97–99% omits lower noisy rows.
For 0.6B with BTL labels log M has slightly larger R² (0.954 vs0.951 BoN;0.949 vs0.947 Tilt); no universal statistically established superiority over log M.
Fits concern observed peaks and tested M range; no full two-dimensional (M,K) out-of-range prediction is validated.
Appendix B.2 reports non-Gaussian gold-score examples; empirical fit does not establish Gaussian reward assumptions in real language.
No independent replication, seed-variance audit, or end-to-end FLOPs/cost comparison performed.

proposed_body_additions.decision: Meaningful T4 synthesis because it explicitly continues the Gao question from scorer capacity to feedback-data constraints. Keep conditional and avoid universal recipe.
